key_insight: A direct stochastic battery dispatch model can cut residential PV-BESS carbon emissions far more effectively than heuristic control, approaching the best-case omniscient limit.
engineering_relevance: The study shows that linear stochastic optimization is a practical way to operate solar-plus-storage systems for lower carbon intensity under uncertain load, PV output, and grid emissions.
method: Built a hierarchy from heuristic self-consumption to fully stochastic linear programs with feedback.
Modeled uncertainty using large scenario sets generated from real operational data via principal component analysis.
Compared anticipated, feedback-based, and omniscient benchmarks for emission-aware battery dispatch.
evidence_signal: On synthetic but realistic scenarios, the programmed battery stochastic model substantially outperformed the heuristic and came close to the omniscient lower bound, while feedback models did not generalize better on unseen data.
watch_item: The most complex feedback formulations increased computational cost without clear out-of-sample gains, so deployment must balance optimization sophistication against runtime and data quality.
paper_title: Comparative Analysis of Linear Battery Models for Carbon Emission Optimization in Solar Energy Systems
